notes.supports: Living relatives begin regularly coiled and later uncoil; article identifies fossil V. recta as Florida Pliocene. Used as genus-level structural analogy, not exact species geometry.

claim_scope: One continuous small regular juvenile helix transitions into a loose irregular adult tube, with a thick-walled round aperture and real internal lumen. Cream/ochre palette. Retain shell only. Correct concept bead-like apex to real continuous coil. Artistic pose, size and color; inspired by fossil V. recta, not a measured specimen replica.
